text: What if you found a jar of gold under land you just bought?
The Prophet, peace be upon him, told us: a man found one. He told the seller: take your gold. I bought the land, not the gold.
The seller said: I sold you the land, and everything in it. Neither would take it.
A man judged between them: Do you have children? A boy. A girl. Marry them, spend on them from it, and give in charity.
They argued to give, not to take. Return one thing today that isn't yours.
